name: zlib-winapi
description: The 2008-06 exe's second zlib 1.2.3 copy (0x7a3e90-0x7a99b0): ZLIB_WINAPI (__stdcall), built with VS2005 50727 (recipe zlib-1.2.3-winapi). G3D links against this copy.
